description: Creates a new revision with the terms you change; omitted terms carry over. Any change after agreement voids it, so both sides must accept again. Nonbinding: never a contract, charge, assignment or dispatch.

account_token.description: Account token, if your account claimed that conversation. Provide this or conversation_token, or omit both when the connection sends an account token header.

anyOf.description: Cancellation terms you propose. Max 2000 characters.

client_request_id.description: Required idempotency key, unique per proposal.

conversation_token.description: Token of the conversation the request belongs to. Provide this or account_token.

deliverables.description: What would be delivered (observations, photos, a report...).

anyOf.description: Evidence you would expect. Max 2000 characters.
General location; "remote" or "virtual" is fine. Max 150 characters.
Optional note shown with this revision. Max 2000 characters.
Indicative, nonbinding price. Never charged by this API.

required_skills.description: Skills or qualifications the human would need.

scope_text.description: What the human would do, and what is out of scope. Max 4000 characters.

anyOf.description: Timing, deadline or duration. Max 200 characters.

valid_days.description: How long this revision stays open, in days (default 14).
